ev.q: In 2020, 3.5% of children aged 5–11 years and 10.9% of adolescents aged 12–17 years reported being tired on most days or every day.
In children aged 5–11 years, the percentage reporting being tired did not differ by hours of screen time
Percentage of U.S. children and adolescents aged 5–17 years who reported being tired most days or every day
Among adolescents aged 12–17, the percentage reporting being tired was higher (12.0%) for those who reported >2 hours of screen time
In children aged 5–11 years, the percentage reporting being tired did not differ by hours of screen time
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
